description: This source file implements SNMP adapter APIs for device information retrieval and setting, including SNMP get/set commands, mapping TR181 parameters to OIDs, and managing SNMP device instances.

classes.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter
classes.description: SNMP Adapter class for managing device SNMP interactions, including parameter mapping, SNMP get/set, and instance management.

methods.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter::getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of the SNMP adapter for a given device ID.

methods.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter::closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific SNMP adapter instance.

methods.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter::closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes and deletes all SNMP adapter instances.

methods.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter::init
methods.description: Initializes the parameter-to-OID map by reading configuration from a file.

methods.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter::get_ValueFromSNMPAdapter
methods.description: Performs SNMP get operation for a given parameter.

methods.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter::set_ValueToSNMPAdapter
methods.description: Performs SNMP set operation for a given parameter.
